User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user within the Omuto Central application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user entity.

role.description: The user's role within the organization (e.g., Program Manager, Operations, Media, ED, Intern, Volunteer).

StrategicPlan.title: StrategicPlan
StrategicPlan.description: Represents a strategic plan for Omuto, such as the October 2025 Operational Plan.

id.description: Unique identifier for the strategic plan entity.

title.description: The title of the strategic plan (e.g., October 2025 Operational Plan).

startDate.description: The start date of the strategic plan.

endDate.description: The end date of the strategic plan.

description.description: A detailed description of the strategic plan.

Objective.title: Objective
Objective.description: Represents a specific objective within a strategic plan.

id.description: Unique identifier for the objective entity.

target.description: The target or goal to be achieved for this objective.

status.description: The current status of the objective (e.g., On Track, Delayed, Completed).

Activity.title: Activity
Activity.description: Represents a specific activity or task performed by Omuto staff.

id.description: Unique identifier for the activity entity.

title.description: The title of the activity (e.g., Tree Planting at St. Mary's).

description.description: A detailed description of the activity.

startDate.description: The planned start date of the activity.

endDate.description: The planned end date of the activity.

status.description: The current status of the activity (e.g., Planned, In Progress, Completed, Cancelled).

actualStartDate.description: The actual start date of the activity.

actualEndDate.description: The actual end date of the activity.

FormTemplate.title: FormTemplate
FormTemplate.description: Represents a template for data input forms.

id.description: Unique identifier for the form template entity.

title.description: The title of the form template (e.g., Weekly Plan, Field Activity ROI Calculator).

description.description: A description of the form template and its purpose.

fields.description: An array of field definitions for the form template.

FormData.title: FormData
FormData.description: Represents data submitted through a form, associated with a specific form template and activity.

id.description: Unique identifier for the form data entity.

submissionDate.description: The date and time when the form data was submitted.

data.description: JSON string containing the submitted data for the form.

Partnership.title: Partnership
Partnership.description: Represents a partnership with another organization.

id.description: Unique identifier for the partnership entity.

name.description: The name of the partner organization.

description.description: A description of the partnership and its goals.

startDate.description: The start date of the partnership.

endDate.description: The end date of the partnership.

contactPerson.description: The name of the primary contact person at the partner organization.

contactEmail.description: The email address of the primary contact person.

Report.title: Report
Report.description: Represents a generated report, either automated or custom.

id.description: Unique identifier for the report entity.

title.description: The title of the report (e.g., Weekly Progress Report, Monthly Financial Report).

reportType.description: The type of report (e.g., Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, Custom).

generationDate.description: The date and time when the report was generated.

userId.description: Reference to User. (Relationship: User 1:N Report) The user who generated the report.

data.description: JSON string containing the report data.

Budget.title: Budget
Budget.description: Represents the budget allocated for a specific period and program.

id.description: Unique identifier for the budget entity.

startDate.description: The start date of the budget period.

endDate.description: The end date of the budget period.

Expenditure.title: Expenditure
Expenditure.description: Represents an expenditure made against a budget.

id.description: Unique identifier for the expenditure entity.

Volunteer.title: Volunteer
Volunteer.description: Represents a volunteer associated with Omuto Foundation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the volunteer entity.

contactNumber.description: The contact number of the volunteer.

email.description: The email address of the volunteer.

skills.description: An array of skills possessed by the volunteer.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to support Omuto Foundation's operational needs, focusing on strategic planning, activity tracking, and data-driven decision-making. The structure prioritizes authorization independence and simplifies security rules by denormalizing authorization data. All data related to a user is stored under the `/users/{userId}` path, ensuring clear ownership and easy rule definition. Collaborative data, such as Strategic Plans, Objectives, Activities, Partnerships, Budgets and reports use a separate collection, with relevant user roles denormalized to the documents to maintain Authorization Independence.

**Authorization Independence and Denormalization:**

*   **User-owned data:** Data like `FormData` and `Reports` created by users are stored under `/users/{userId}` ensuring that only the user and admins can access it. This eliminates the need for complex `get()` calls in security rules.
*   **Collaborative data:** Strategic Plans, Objectives, Activities, Partnerships, Budgets are accessible by team members with the appropriate roles. The structure denormalizes the user's role into these collections, avoiding `get()` calls to `/users/{userId}`.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):**

*   **Segregation:** The structure segregates data based on access control needs. User-specific data resides under `/users/{userId}`, while collaborative data resides in top-level collections.
*   **Membership Map (Denormalized Role):** The `role` property in entities such as `StrategicPlan`, `Objective`, `Activity`, `Partnership`, `Budget` and `Report` enables secure `list` operations. Rules can efficiently check if the user's role matches the required role without fetching additional documents.

**Explanation of Paths:**

*   `/users/{userId}`: Stores individual user profiles, ensuring private user data is accessible only to the user and authorized admins.
*   `/strategic_plans/{strategicPlanId}`: Stores strategic plans. Includes the user role for authorization.
*   `/strategic_plans/{strategicPlanId}/objectives/{objectiveId}`: Stores objectives related to a strategic plan. Includes the user role for authorization.
*   `/activities/{activityId}`: Stores activities performed by users. Includes the user role for authorization.
*   `/form_templates/{formTemplateId}`: Stores form templates. Accessible to admins for creating forms.
*   `/partnerships/{partnershipId}`: Stores partnership information. Includes the user role for authorization.
*   `/budgets/{budgetId}`: Stores budgets allocated for strategic plans. Includes the user role for authorization.
*   `/expenditures/{expenditureId}`: Stores expenditure data, associated with budgets and activities.
*   `/volunteers/{volunteerId}`: Stores volunteer data. Accessed by admins.
*   `/users/{userId}/form_data/{formDataId}`: Stores form data submitted by a user.
*   `/users/{userId}/reports/{reportId}`: Stores reports generated by a user.
